design.freshSeedRule: serverSeed = sha256(label) as lowercase hex; clientSeed = label

classes.seedLabels: each class on its own seed labels (rank and side in the label); no round is shared

pass2.earlyWindow: nonces 1 … n, n = the rounds the capture played on the seed
pass2.slot: nonce i plays the (i − 1) mod n-th captured round of the seed in nonce order, by its first guess: the rank it was made on and its side, judged by the stream card at that guess's place (after the same skips); win iff the side wins on that card's rank
pass2.units: byN = per button n [rounds, wins]; Phase A epochs also carry the payout-weighted return: ret8 = sum of multipliers on wins in 1e-8 units; mean13 = sum multiplier8 × n (divide by 13 for 1e-8 units); var169 = sum multiplier8² × n × (13 − n) (divide by 169 for 1e-16 units)
